summary: After upgrading from 2.4, platform gateway manages OAUTH2_PROVIDER settings; default access token expiry drops from 1,000 years to 1 year, with REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE_SECONDS 2628000 and AUTHORIZATION_CODE_EXPIRE_SECONDS 600. Shorter custom expirations must be re-set manually in gateway.
questions: What are the default OAUTH2_PROVIDER settings in platform gateway?
Why did token expiration change after upgrading to 2.6?
Do I need to reconfigure token expiration after upgrade?
What is the default refresh token expiration?

answer_card.title: Default OAUTH2_PROVIDER in platform gateway
answer_card.answer_md:
```json
{
  "ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_SECONDS": 31536000000,
  "REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE_SECONDS": 2628000,
  "AUTHORIZATION_CODE_EXPIRE_SECONDS": 600
}
```
After a 2.4 to 2.6 upgrade the gateway manages these. If you had set expirations shorter than one year in controller, set them again in the gateway settings.
